newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa to swap 2 shares for 5 UAP shares -mkt sources.
newsitem.headline: Axa to swap 2 shares for 5 UAP shares -mkt sources.

text.p: The Paris stock market is expecting a planned merger between Axa and Union des Assurances de Paris (UAP) to be made on the basis of two Axa shares for five UAP shares, market sources said on Tuesday.
There may also be a possibility of a cash option, the sources said.
Officials from the two companies, which are due to hold a joint news conference at 1200 GMT, declined all comment on the terms of the merger.
Afternoon daily Le Monde said that the merger would be on the basis of four Axa shares for 10 UAP shares.

This would mean UAP shareholders were selling their shares at the equivalent of 127.40 francs, given that Axa shares last traded at 318.50 francs. Shares in Axa and UAP were suspended on Tuesday at the companies' request.
UAP was privatised in 1994 at 152 francs per share.
Le Monde said UAP shareholders would also be offered certificates of contingent value to be paid depending on how much the value of the shares rose by 1999.
